title: Paul McCartney live: National Indoor Arena, Birmingham | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the National Indoor Arena in Birmingham, England, on 13 April 2003.

It was the ninth date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003, and the first of two consecutive nights in Birmingham.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Birmingham Arena on 27 May 2015 during the On The Run Tour.
